page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn8is.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor clocked at 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU core.

Acceleration is delivered via a single NVIDIA L20 GPU from the Ada Lovelace architecture, which includes 48 GB of dedicated VRAM. This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached network storage volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn8is.4xlarge offers a specialized balance of dedicated Intel Xeon compute, high-capacity GPU memory, and a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. This profile is designed for workloads that require significant GPU memory capacity but do not demand local high-speed storage. Suitable workloads include machine learning inference, data science pipelines, graphics rendering, and memory-intensive GPU-accelerated computing.
